claims: Geno Auriemma is a Hall of Fame head coach.
Geno Auriemma has led the UConn Huskies women’s basketball team since 1985.
Geno Auriemma has won 11 NCAA National Championships.
Geno Auriemma has won multiple Olympic gold medals.
Geno Auriemma has over 1,200 career wins.
This video shows a post-game interview with Geno Auriemma after a tournament win.
